decode_as: Abstract "reset all" call for DCE/RPC

Create a new function pointer for dissectors that use Decode As functionality to do a "reset all" called within decode_clear_all().  Currently this is only used by DCE/RPC given its complex Decode As structure, but removes dissector specific functionality from Decode As functionality.
